build_control_review.reason: Reviewed dev synchronization adds isolated non-committing merge preflight, on-demand fixture restoration, unified delivery watching and cache restore identity. Makefile changes since the prior review only add preflight merge arguments and a check-fast test; the Git workflow documents merge scanning and watcher coordination. Product build rules, RTL, SDK, hardware profiles, dependency pins and the frozen product source revision remain unchanged. Later control-file edits require a fresh explicit review.
